pickle.name: Complete a row with only one missing value

steps.text: a standard 9x9 Sudoku grid is initialized
a row contains the values "1, 2, 0, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9"
the "Unit Completion" algorithm scans the row
the system should identify the missing value as 3
the value 3 should be placed in the empty cell

pickle.name: Identify a Hidden Single in a row

steps.text: a standard 9x9 Sudoku grid is initialized
row 3 is missing the number 6
8 cells in row 3 cannot contain 6 due to column or block constraints
the "Hidden Singles" algorithm is executed for value 6
the system should place 6 in the only valid cell in row 3
the grid should reflect the new value

pickle.name: Reject JSON boolean puzzle cell values on load

steps.text: a standard 9x9 Sudoku grid is initialized
a puzzle with a JSON boolean cell value of "true"
the PuzzleLoader attempts to load the file
a validation error should be thrown

pickle.name: Audit trail attributes changes to the correct algorithm

the solver attempts to solve it with audit
